manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Oblivion Ring until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Journey to Nowhere from exile to the battlefield.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Journey to Nowhere.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
